'''Selene Jean''' is a ship Engineer based at '''Prospector's Rest''' in the '''Kuk''' system. A former miner, she specialises in strengthening ship hulls and reinforcement packages.<ref name="edwiki-selene">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Selene_Jean Selene Jean], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Selene provides '''Grade 5''' engineering for [[Armour]] and [[Hull Reinforcement Package|Hull Reinforcement Packages]]. In Live, she also provides the Operations-era '''Heavy Duty''' blueprint for compatible [[Module Reinforcement Package|Module Reinforcement Packages]] through Grade 5.<ref name="inara-selene">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/8/ Selene Jean — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Location ==

* '''System:''' Kuk
* '''Body:''' Kuk B 3
* '''Facility:''' Prospector's Rest
* '''Engineer scope:''' Ship armour and reinforcement
* '''Referral required:''' [[Tod "The Blaster" McQuinn]]
* '''System permit required:''' No

== Access requirements ==

Access to Selene Jean has three stages:<ref name="inara-selene" /><ref name="edwiki-selene" />

# Reach '''Grade 3 access plus at least one-third progress toward Grade 4''' with [[Tod "The Blaster" McQuinn]] to receive her referral.
# Mine and refine at least '''500 tonnes of ore'''.
# Provide '''10 units of mined [[Painite]]''' at Prospector's Rest.

The mining threshold is cumulative; the full 500 tonnes do not need to be retained or delivered to Selene. The Painite contribution is a separate final requirement.

For mining equipment, prospecting, refining, and collection mechanics, see [[Mining]]. The complete ordered access process belongs to [[Unlocking Selene Jean]].

== Workshop reputation ==

Reputation with Selene Jean increases by:<ref name="inara-selene" />

* crafting modifications at her workshop;
* selling commodities at Prospector's Rest; or
* selling exploration data at Prospector's Rest.

Higher reputation opens the grades that Selene supports. INARA notes that station services may not appear immediately after the first unlock; beginning a new game session can make those services available.<ref name="inara-selene" />

The available modification families, effects, trade-offs, and recipes belong to [[Engineering Blueprints]]. Compatible secondary modifications belong to [[Experimental Effects]].

=== Operations-era service ===

The '''Heavy Duty Module Reinforcement Package''' blueprint is part of the Operations-era Engineering additions. It improves module protection while increasing mass, can be applied only to compatible Merc modules, and is available from Selene through Grade 5.<ref name="frontier-operations">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-0-0 Elite Dangerous: Operations — Update Notes], Frontier Developments, 30 June 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="inara-mrp-heavy">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/214/ Module Reinforcement Package — Heavy Duty], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

This service is not part of Legacy Engineering. Its exact modifiers, costs, and compatible variants belong to the Heavy Duty [[Engineering Blueprints|Blueprint]] record rather than this Engineer article.

== Blueprint pinning and remote work ==

After sufficient reputation has been earned, one Selene Jean blueprint can be pinned for use through [[Remote Engineering]]. A pinned blueprint cannot exceed the grade she offers, and Experimental Effects still require an appropriate workshop visit.

== Direct referrals ==

Selene Jean directly introduces two Engineers after the Commander reaches Grade 3 access and progresses approximately one-third of the way toward Grade 4 with her:

* '''[[Bill Turner]]'''<ref name="inara-bill">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/19/ Bill Turner — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
* '''[[Didi Vatermann]]'''<ref name="inara-didi">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/11/ Didi Vatermann — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Each referral reveals an Engineer; it does not satisfy that Engineer's own meeting or unlock requirements. Their locations, requirements, services, and later referrals belong to their individual articles. For the complete network, see [[Engineer Unlock Guide]].
